Name: Prestige Perfection
Author: kurtsietz
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You reached Perfection. Now do it again — better.

Prestige adds a full New Game+ loop to Stardew Valley 1.6. After earning Perfection, a golden statue appears at the Summit. Offer your life to it, sleep, and wake up on Spring 1, Year 1 with a fresh world, a new farm type of your choice — and permanent rewards that stack across every life.

[b]The loop:[/b][/color][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Reach [b]Perfection[/b] and visit the Summit. A golden statue awaits.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Interact with it. You'll be warned: [i]when you fall asleep, you will go back to Spring 1, Year 1.[/i][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Sleep. The [b]Prestige Menu[/b] opens: choose your next farm type, spend prestige points on the skill tree, and preview your next starter gift.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Begin your new life. Your character survives; the world resets like a brand-new save — same save file, no load-screen clutter, and your completed life is automatically archived to Saves\PrestigeBackups.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (4.1.7 or newer).[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder (or install with Vortex).[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI. Done — the statue appears at the Summit once you reach Perfection.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]To remove the mod, delete the Prestige folder from Mods. Your save keeps working (prestige data simply goes dormant).[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Prestige points[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Any prestige: [b]1 point[/b][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Joja-free[/b] prestige (no membership, no perfection waivers, no golden parrot): [b]2 points[/b][/color][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Farm passives — permanent buffs for completing runs[/b]
The farm you prestige [i]from[/i] gains a level (max 5). All earned passives apply on every future run.[/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Standard[/b]: crops grow 1 day faster per level (total growth never below 1 day)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Meadowlands[/b]: +20 petting friendship per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Forest[/b]: +1 extra daily forage on the farm per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Four Corners[/b]: +15 talking friendship per level (starts at +35)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Wilderness[/b]: +1 attack per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Hill-top[/b]: +1 ore per node per level (copper/iron/gold/iridium/radioactive/cinder)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Beach[/b]: +1 crab pot loot per level (non-trash)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Riverland[/b]: +30px fishing bar per level[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]The skill tree[/b]
A speed-centric hub: unlock [b]Speed Boost[/b] first (+0.25 speed per level, max 4), then spend points on nine branches. Every level costs 1 point.[/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Fiber[/b] (max 6): +25 fiber in your starter gift box per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Wood[/b] (max 6): +50 wood per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Gold[/b] (max 4): +200g starting money per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Moss[/b] (max 6): +15 moss per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Tools[/b] (max 4): start with Copper → Steel → Gold → Iridium tools[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Books[/b] (max 12): permanently keep one book power per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Backpack[/b] (max 2): start with 24, then 36 inventory slots[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Skill EXP[/b] (max 3): +10% skill experience gain per level[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Profit[/b] (uncapped): +1% sell price per level, forever stacking[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]The starter gift ladder[/b]
Every prestige replaces the parsnip seeds in your Spring 1 gift box with the next item on a 21-step ladder — previewed in the prestige menu so you always know what's coming.[/color][/size]
[spoiler][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
Seed Maker · Rain Totem x5 · Fiberglass Rod · Carrot Seeds x30 · Deluxe Scarecrow · Quality Sprinkler · Crab Pot x5 · Dinosaur Egg · Explosive Ammo x50 · Garden Pot x20 · Mahogany Seed x20 · Wild Bait x100 · Ancient Seeds · Rabbit's Foot x15 · Book of Stars · Mushroom Log x5 · Monster Musk x15 · Iridium Sprinkler · Crystalarium x2 · Prismatic Shard · Treasure Chest — then it repeats![/color][/size][/spoiler]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]The Dream Journal[/b]
Once you've prestiged, Robin sells the [b]Dream Journal[/b] (1,000g). Place it in your home and interact with it any time to review your prestige progress: farm levels, skill tree, points, and your next starter gift.

[b]Quality of life[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]One save folder forever; each completed life is auto-archived to Saves\PrestigeBackups (invisible to the load screen, restorable by moving a folder).[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Mystery boxes, the earthquake, story events — everything resets authentically, because the reset uses the game's own new-game code path.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Console diagnostics: prestige_status and prestige_passivecheck.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Config: passives global vs. current-farm-only; the Books unlock order.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.7 or newer[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or newer[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Single-player only[/b][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Compatibility notes: prefix/postfix Harmony patches only (no transpilers), so compatibility with other mods is high; custom farm types are treated as Standard; item retextures apply to all menu icons automatically.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, and Pathoschild for SMAPI — the foundation every mod stands on. Designed on a wall of whiteboards and built with Claude.[/color][/size]
